title: Site creation: a failed build retries instead of IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, Joomla installs only on the MariaDB that stays up, and deleting a site mid-build ends its provision job
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run: node tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1181-create-retry-provision.mjs
S2: Read one ok/not ok line per check.
expect: P-1: a nameless claim whose provision failed, pressed again with the same build id and draft label, answers 202 attempt 2 with a second host provision; the same build id with another design still answers 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

P-2: provision.sh waits until the db service answers skip_networking=0 (the server that stays up) before the dump import and the Joomla CLI installer; a server that stays the temporary one never passes.

P-3: DELETE /api/sites/:key on a site whose provision job is still open leaves that job row state=failed, step=site-deleted, detail.code=SITE_DELETED, and the quiet-jobs sweep does not reopen it; a job that had already ended keeps its state; another site's open job is untouched.
fence: nameless check in POST /api/sites (sites/route.js); tracy_db_wait_ready in scripts/lib/db-ready.sh; deleteTornDownSite in sites/publish-store.js
